title: AS2: switch statement
description: The AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts) may lack switch/case support. In AVM1, switch compiles using jump tables or if-else chains. Implement switch compilation: compileSwitchStmt should iterate cases, emit comparison pushes + conditional jumps, with break handled via backpatched jumps. Handle default case. Add unit tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/switch.test.ts covering: single case, multiple cases, default case, fall-through (no break), break within case, nested switch.
